about_short_description.short_description: Proven Skincare is a skincare company that provides users with scientific, clean, and specifically effective products.

product.name: PROVEN Personalized Skincare System
product.description: A personalized three-step skincare routine consisting of a cleanser, day moisturizer, and night cream formulated from an individual’s skin profile, environment, and lifestyle factors.

product.name: PROVEN Personalized Acne Treatment
product.description: A personalized skincare routine for acne that uses an individual’s skin, environmental, lifestyle, and hormonal information to select ingredients and concentrations for a cleanser, moisturizer, and night cream.

product.name: PROVEN Personalized Dark-Spot Moisturizer
product.description: A customized day moisturizer formulated to address an individual’s dark spots and support protection against new discoloration, with ingredients and concentrations selected from a personal skin profile.

identifier.value: PROVEN Skin Analysis and AI Formulation Service

product.name: PROVEN Skin Analysis and AI Formulation Service
product.description: An online skin assessment and formulation service that maps customer responses to a skincare database to determine personalized ingredient selections and concentrations.

identifier.value: PROVEN Adaptive Subscription and Reformulation Service

product.name: PROVEN Adaptive Subscription and Reformulation Service
product.description: A recurring skincare service that delivers personalized formulas on a selected schedule and supports formula adjustments when a customer’s skin, environment, or results change.
